I will solve the change of basis problem.
I will solve the projection problem.
I will solve the linear system problem.
I will solve the basis coordinates problem.
I will solve the QR decomposition problem.
I will solve the rank problem.
I will solve the rref problem.
I will solve the Gram determinant problem.

context.instruction: Final step. The team chat below has every answer. Return one finish action with all answers, copied exactly.

results.notes: Solved the linear system B c = v and B c = w by Gaussian elimination on the augmented 9x18 matrix, reducing to reduced row echelon form to obtain the coordinates.
Computed the inverse of B via Gaussian elimination, then multiplied B^{-1} (A B) to get C. All entries are integers.

Computed the 6x6 Gram matrix of dot products, then performed Gaussian elimination with integer scaling to find the determinant. After tracking all scaling factors, the final quotient simplified to 2800.
Computed the normal equations AᵀA x = Aᵀb, solved the 6×6 system exactly via Gaussian elimination with fractions, and back-substituted to get the least-squares solution.
Solved the 10x10 linear system using Gaussian elimination with rational arithmetic, performing row operations to get upper triangular form and back substituting to find exact solution.
Computed the product of all 23 matrices sequentially via matrix multiplication, then summed the diagonal entries of the final 3x3 matrix to obtain the trace.
Found a basis for the orthogonal complement of W by solving M^T v=0, then projected b onto that 2D subspace and subtracted from b to get the orthogonal projection onto W.
Applied Gram-Schmidt to columns of A, computing squared norms of orthogonal vectors via recurrence and projection formula. Used exact rational arithmetic to obtain each R_ii^2.
Performed Gaussian elimination on the 12x12 matrix. Found pivot positions in columns 1, 3, 7, 8, 10, 11 after row reduction, yielding rank 6.
Computed the RREF by Gaussian elimination: used row operations to get leading 1s in columns 1,2,3,4,7,8,9 and zeros elsewhere in those columns, resulting in 7 pivot rows and one zero row.
